description: This file implements pager functionality for a Git-like application, managing external pager processes, terminal size detection, environment setup, and configuration handling.

methods.name: close_pager_fds
methods.description: Closes file descriptors to signal EOF to the pager.

methods.name: finish_pager
methods.description: Flushes output and finishes the pager command.

methods.name: wait_for_pager_atexit
methods.description: Ensures pager is finished at program exit.

methods.name: wait_for_pager
methods.description: Waits for the pager process to complete and restores original file descriptors.

methods.name: wait_for_pager_signal
methods.description: Handles signal to terminate pager process.

methods.name: core_pager_config
methods.description: Reads pager configuration from git config.

methods.name: git_pager
methods.description: Determines the pager command to use based on environment and config.

methods.name: setup_pager_env
methods.description: Sets up environment variables for the pager process.

methods.name: prepare_pager_args
methods.description: Prepares arguments for spawning the pager process.

methods.name: setup_pager
methods.description: Initializes and spawns the pager process, redirects output.

methods.name: pager_in_use
methods.description: Checks if the pager is currently in use.

methods.name: term_columns
methods.description: Returns the number of terminal columns, using cache or ioctl.

methods.name: decimal_width
methods.description: Calculates the width needed to display a number in decimal.

methods.name: pager_command_config
methods.description: Reads pager command configuration from git config.

methods.name: check_pager_config
methods.description: Checks pager configuration for a specific command.
